subject: Change order: scope recon & integration schedule — HyperPulse
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@hyperpulse.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: HyperPulse Contracts <contracts@hyperpulse.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our engineering team confirmed we need an additional 2 TB of KV cache capacity and would like to shift the integration cutover from July 20 -> August 17 to accommodate a blackout at our end. Attached is our proposed change order (HyperPulse_ChangeOrder_v3.docx) and a PDF with inline redlines.

High level asks:
- +2TB KV cache (dedicated pool) starting 2025-07-01
- One-time pro rata charge for May–June to cover early provisioning
- Move integration window to Aug 17–Aug 31, with a short overlap rollback plan

Can you confirm the commercial impact and whether Redwood legal needs anything else to expedite sign-off? We ideally want this signed by the 23rd.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
VP, Platform Operations
HyperPulse Inc

Attachments: HyperPulse_ChangeOrder_v3.docx, redlines_hyperpulse_20250512.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@hyperpulse.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Elena —

Received, thanks for the clear outline and the redlines. Quick read: the +2TB request maps to a dedicated pool supplement; I can give a preliminary cost delta and pro rata stub by end of day.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I'll loop in Karthik (legal) and Laura (implementation lead) to review the redlines and confirm whether the rollback language needs tightening.
2) We will run a capacity availability check and confirm ETA for provisioning (expecting early July possible).
3) If legal signs off on the redlines we can route to DocuSign; I'll push for the 23rd target but will flag any gating items.

Cc: Karthik, Laura, Marissa for tracking.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Team — forwarding HyperPulse's request. Key items to evaluate:
- Commercial: pro rata charge for May–June, monthly delta for +2TB dedicated KV pool, and whether to grandfather rate tiers.
- Legal: redlines in PDF (see attachment). Primary concerns: rollback SLA language, data isolation clause for dedicated pool, and indemnity tweaks around third-party integrations.
- Implementation: confirm whether provisioning timeline (targeting 2025-07-01) is feasible and any constraints on the Aug 17–31 integration window.

Laura: can you fill the integration_window_worksheet.xlsx and indicate earliest safe cutover dates + a rollback plan?
Karthik: please advise on whether the PDF redlines are acceptable or whether we need to counter with an amendment that preserves Redwood's standard MSA provisions.

I'll draft a short commercial summary to send back to HyperPulse after the internal check.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: redlines_hyperpulse_20250512.pdf, integration_window_worksheet.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Jonas / team —

High-level legal review after quick pass:
- Dedicated pool language: acceptable but add explicit data segregation sentence and reference to customer-specific KMS scope. I'll propose: "Customer data and KV caches will be isolated to Customer's dedicated instances; keys are managed via Customer KMS when enabled."
- Rollback plan: the client's suggested window is fine but we need an explicit cutover acceptance test and an SLA for rollback initiation (we typically allow a 24-hour rollback trigger following failed acceptance).
- Indemnity: redline requests that broaden vendor liability are not acceptable. I'll prepare limited counters that keep standard MSA indemnity but add clarifying language about third-party connectors.

I'll attach a 1-page redline summary in the same doc and send a tracked-change amendment if you want to take that externally.

Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: legal_summary_redlines_20250516.docx

From: Elena Soto <esoto@hyperpulse.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: HyperPulse Contracts <contracts@hyperpulse.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick internal review. A couple notes from our side after legal looked:
- We accepted the KMS language but still want the rollback SLA to be 48 hours instead of 24. Our platform team needs extra time for state reconciliation.
- Commercial: agreed to the monthly delta you proposed in principle, but we asked contracts to see final pro rata numbers and a one-time provisioning fee.

Attached is a cleaned up DOCX with inline changes from our side (HyperPulse_ChangeOrder_v3.docx). If you can provide a countersigned amendment with Karthik's limited indemnity language and the 48-hour rollback ask noted, we can route for approval on our side.

Also, we've uploaded an internal runbook excerpt to our shared drive: [Link withheld].

Thanks — can we target next Wednesday (May 28) for the countersigned doc?

- Elena

Attachments: HyperPulse_ChangeOrder_v3.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@hyperpulse.com>, HyperPulse Contracts <contracts@hyperpulse.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: change order to add throughput & shift integration window

Elena —

Thanks — this is helpful. Short status update and next steps: 
1) Commercial: I'm attaching (internal) the pro rata stub and monthly delta estimate; provisioning fee proposal is $12,000 one-time (covers engineer time + reserved capacity ramp). I'll send the numeric breakdown to contracts separately.
2) Legal: Karthik will prepare a tracked-change amendment that accepts the KMS sentence, pushes back on expanded indemnity, and records the rollback SLA at 48 hours as a negotiable term.
3) Implementation: Laura confirmed provisioning ETA 2025-07-02 if PO and countersigned change order are completed by May 28. She also noted the Aug 17–31 window is feasible but recommends a dry-run on Aug 10–12.

Action items:
- Karthik: please produce the tracked-change amendment by EOD Thu.
- Jonas (me): I'll consolidate the commercial numbers and route the change order + amendment to DocuSign with the HP countersigns requested.
- Laura/Marissa: prepare the dry-run checklist and share by May 26.

I'll follow up with a DocuSign link once legal delivers. If HyperPulse can confirm PO cadence, that will help speed provisioning.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
